verified: RE-VERIFIED, and a probe-side defect worth 30% of a real value was found and fixed. tools/_probe_crane.mjs vs CraneProbe.cs (run inside VerifyPass4Probe, then again inside VerifyPass4bProbe after the fixes). TWO PROBE BUGS, both mine to fix, both found by this sweep: (1) the JS probe's switch-ramp loop declared `const sw = {v:0}` OUTSIDE the sample loop but restarted `acc` at 0 for every sample time, so it integrated 0+0.25+0.5+0.715+1.0 = 2.465 s of ramp instead of 1.0 s and reported CRANE_SWITCH_LO_T0_50_AIRSPEED=500.000 FRAC=1.0000 where one continuous ramp is at 350.000/0.7000. CraneProbe.cs:58-64 integrates the DELTA from the previous sample (`float prev`), which is the correct reading of "sample the ramp at t"; the C# was right. Fixed tools/_probe_crane.mjs to carry `prev` the same way -- both sides now read 0/0.25->175/0.35, 0.50->350/0.70, 0.71->500/1.00, 1.00->500/1.00. (2) three booleans (CRANE_CABLE_NEVER_BELOW_FLOOR, CRANE_CABLE_RAW_DIP_BELOW_FLOOR, CRANE_SWITCH_LO_REACHED_TARGET) printed as C#'s `True` against JS's `true`, which changes the line's shape so the tool skipped them silently -- the documented casing trap, lower-cased in CraneProbe.cs. Also pinned the t=0.715 sample's TAG to the literal "0_71" because C# formats 0.715f as "0.72" and JS's toFixed(2) gives "0.71", so that sample's two lines never paired even though their values agree. After the fixes: 42 values across 46 js / 46 cs lines (was 40 across 46/44), the Catmull-Rom floor clamp, the rider basis, the hook/cable samples and the whole switch ramp all exact. TWO lines deliberately still unpaired, NOT port bugs: CRANE_FAN{0,1,2}_X reads 9.9 js vs -10.1 cs because CraneProbe.cs:34-41's own header says it feeds the RAW un-mirrored JS hook as a before/after comparison point and points at WarehouseCraneFillProbe's CRANEFILL_FANALG lines as the real, correctly-mirrored proof (hook.x=-0.1 either way, fan offset +10 in the game frame, -10 in Unity's -- the expected X mirror); and CRANE_FAN_PITCH_SEPARATION 7.0000 vs 7.0003 is a float32 tie at 4.3e-05.
